name: SharedSignals External Agent API
production_host_note: Production listens on localhost behind the SharedSignals server boundary. The intended external hostname is https://signals.tradingagent.cc, but it is usable only after Cloudflare Tunnel ingress/DNS and Access policy are bound to the SharedSignals origin.

boundary.role: Read-only trading data supply layer for minute and 5-minute workflows.
hard_forbidden: Do not call Tushare, Binance, Polymarket, CSV, NDJSON, SQLite files, old RSS directories, or sibling repository internals directly.
Do not treat allowlisted Tushare names as production-fresh unless the endpoint metadata and capability plan show active collection.
Do not fallback to provider or local files when SharedSignals returns empty or degraded data.

auth.external_read_scope: Full SharedSignals data read surface including /tushare read-model output. Excludes /cache/invalidate, provider keys, file/database access, and production writes.

internal.audience: Nicholas-approved internal users and trusted internal agents
internal.notes: Full SharedSignals data read surface without hourly quota; still excludes provider keys, database/file access, production writes, and /cache/invalidate unless explicitly granted.

enterprise.notes: Requires explicit contract, gateway policy, audit, and capacity review.

fail_closed_rule: If data is empty, stale, degraded, outside the expected cadence, or missing provenance, return data_unavailable instead of routing around SharedSignals.

primary_endpoints.use: Check API, cron, SLA, and read-model health before trading data reads.
Discover currently registered endpoint capabilities.
Fetch this external-agent integration contract.
Read green/yellow/red source governance status before relying on market data.
Inspect API cache generation, TTL, entry count, and auth dedup cache summary.
Operator-controlled API cache invalidation. This clears API cache only; it never deletes read-model data.
Daily or intraday OHLCV from the read model.
A-share or Futures 5-minute bars only.
Trading-day check from read model with safe weekday fallback for future or unavailable dates.
News, announcements, reports, and event rows from market_events.

Derived sentiment-style event projection over market_events. Sources are configured in reference/sentiment_event_types.yaml (default: sentiment, major_news, news, cctv_news). Consumers must accept degraded/empty when no configured source has rows.
Financial and fundamental factors from market_factors.
Explicit read-model reference table access. Retired CSV reference files return degraded.
Industry, sector, concept, and chain fields from market_assets.
Macro, rates, FX, repo, and global factor rows.
A-share flow factors; not a 5-minute price feed.
Crypto read-model output from Binance collector.
Polymarket market metadata with latest price join.
Polymarket price snapshots.
Event-to-security association projection when synced into SharedSignals; degraded/empty is valid when delegated research data is absent.
Impact relationship projection when synced into SharedSignals; degraded/empty is valid when delegated research data is absent.
Native Tushare-shaped read-model output. This never calls Tushare live.

market_frequency_labels.Events: 30min full event lane plus 15min news/major_news pilot refresh

data_source_onboarding.horizontal_expansion_status: planned_only; candidates are not production collectors until onboarding gates pass
mandatory_artifacts: external agent config update when externally consumable
data_source_onboarding.rule: A new data source is not production-ready until it can collect, write SQLite read-model rows, expose DB-first API/reader output or explicit degraded semantics, and pass coverage tests without CSV/NDJSON/provider fallback.
